case_classification.short_description: Sum of the Parts Valuation using Comp multiples, easy DCF, full fletch 3-SM DCF for 5 company parts in total

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: This is an exceptionally comprehensive and complex sum-of-the-parts valuation model involving five separate business lines. The most time-consuming parts are the monthly 3-statement models for 'Fixings' and 'Plastic Parts'. Fixings requires a detailed monthly operational model, including a complex 24-month vintage cohort PP&E schedule with dynamic CapEx solver formulas, shift-based labor calculations, a monthly annuity loan amortization, and lagged tax/distribution payout schedules. Plastic Parts requires establishing a monthly workday calendar (excluding weekends) over 10 years to dynamically calculate compounding exponents for P&L and BS growth, balanced with a cash plug. Additionally, the modeler must build two separate public comps databases, perform an annual mid-year convention DCF with a linearly weighted terminal value, solve iterative WACCs, and build robust lookup formulas to answer over 100 highly specific monthly financial questions.
